fusions.name: Plucked Ember
fusions.desc: Costs 5% of your maximum health. Flings one of your own burning feathers into the first enemy it meets for 8 damage, setting it [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Falling Star
fusions.desc: Hurtles up to 7 tiles onto the target for 13 damage, setting it [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds and leaving it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Thermal Updraft
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 35% for 8 seconds and lifts you 2 tiles from where you stood, and your dodge chance rises by 10%.

fusions.name: Pyre Rebirth
fusions.desc: Once your health falls below 30%, you regain 4 health a second for 6 seconds. Once every 60 seconds.
